tickets.title: Evaluate and set up self-employed retirement plan
tickets.text: Compare the projected home equity line reset payment with refinance, fixed home equity loan, and accelerated payoff alternatives for Evan and Lena Cloudpuddle. This analysis must account for the estimated reset payment and the current $86,400 outstanding balance at Silver Marmot Credit Union.

subTasks.title: Gather self-employment profile and contribution goals
subTasks.text: Collect business structure, earned income range, employee status, existing retirement accounts, cash-flow variability, and desired employer/employee contribution capacity.

subTasks.title: Compare eligible plan structures
subTasks.text: Prepare a side-by-side summary of plan types, contribution limits, setup requirements, administration burden, Roth availability if relevant, loan provisions if relevant, and tax considerations.

subTasks.title: Coordinate setup documentation
subTasks.text: Identify required adoption agreements, custodian forms, funding instructions, and payroll or bookkeeping steps needed before contributions can begin.

subTasks.title: Confirm first-year operating checklist
subTasks.text: Create a reusable checklist for contribution timing, recordkeeping, annual filings if applicable, and coordination with the client's CPA.
